list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden (as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; guides are this app's own words and cite their sources.

roadmap.text: Play the story straight through. Earns: all 12 story chapter/mission trophies (Just Like Paradise through Snow Storm) plus the stranger strands you meet on the way. Keep a manual save before every major choice.
roadmap.title: Story playthrough — Chapters 1–4

roadmap.text: Do these BEFORE the final mission: the 2 partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the one-time scenes (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Let's Go Bowling), the VCIA departure, the choice trophies (Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess) and the strange encounter (The Truth Is Out There). 10 missables in total — this is the only stage you cannot redo freely.
roadmap.title: Missables — during the story

roadmap.text: Complete the final mission (gold), then finish all 8 stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone + 3 more) in free roam. Earns: the finale gold and Strangers & Freaks silver.
roadmap.title: Finale + stranger strands

roadmap.text: Region by region: 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, all meditation spots, 100 vehicles discovered, all garage properties, explore all of Leonida. Nothing here is missable — free roam is your friend.
roadmap.title: Collectibles sweep

roadmap.text: Shooting Range gold on all 42 challenges, 250 stunts, 20 race wins, drone races at every location, 50 challenges, banks, trucks, gang operations, hunting, fishing vs Cal, bowling, money laundering ($250k) and spending ($100k).
roadmap.title: Activities & grinds

roadmap.text: Check the in-game 100% checklist, mop up anything left, and A Long Road (gold) pops — then Vice Got a Price! (platinum) follows automatically.
roadmap.title: 100% + Platinum

sources.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through this guide's roadmap in order (story first, missables during the story, then collectibles and activities) and it will unlock on its own. Source: the official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); roadmap in this app.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Earn all 54 other trophies — the platinum pops automatically, with nothing extra to do for it.
Follow the roadmap in order: story first, missables during the story, then collectibles and activities.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end — it is the first story mission of the game, so this trophy is unmissable and unlocks naturally within the first hour. Follow the on-screen objectives; there is no alternate path or fail state that can lock it out. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); mission name per the official description.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end — it is the first story mission of the game.
Follow the on-screen objectives; there is no alternate path or fail state that can lock it out.
It unlocks naturally within the first hour of play.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter's closing cutscene. Chapters are linear, so just keep playing the golden story markers on the map until the chapter turns over. Nothing here can be missed. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops at the chapter's closing cutscene — chapters are linear, so keep playing the golden story markers on the map until the chapter turns over. Nothing here can be missed.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Keep following the story markers — chapter trophies are story-locked and unmissable, so no side content is needed for this one. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2.
The trophy pops when the chapter ends; chapter trophies are story-locked and unmissable, so no side content is needed.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. By now the map has opened up — resist the urge to wander off for too long if you want this quickly, but nothing in the chapter can be missed. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end; nothing in the chapter can be missed, so play at your own pace.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. This is the last numbered chapter before the finale, so once it pops you are one step from the gold finale trophy. Unmissable — story only. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4.
This is the last numbered chapter before the finale, so once it pops you are one step from the gold finale trophy. Unmissable — story only.

trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission. It unlocks after Chapter 4; before you start it, finish any missable partner and choice trophies first (see the Missable section of the roadmap), because the finale is the natural point of no return. The trophy itself is unmissable — you only need to beat the mission once. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); roadmap in this app.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Complete the game's final story mission, which unlocks after Chapter 4.

Mission trophies are unmissable; if the marker has not appeared yet, keep playing story missions until it does. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (pause menu > Stats > 100% Checklist). It counts story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and the big grinds in this guide — effectively everything else on this list plus the checklist's own entries. Save this for last: do the story, then the missables, then work the checklist top to bottom, ticking trophies off here as you go. It is the second gold and the real endgame of the platinum. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); checklist structure per PowerPyx's 100% guide.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime, drifts and other stunt moves the game counts in its stunt tracker (pause menu > Stats). The fastest way is a fast bike or car on long highway runs: chain airtime off ramps with near-misses in traffic, and repeat. It is a grind, not a skill gate, and it can be done any time after the story in free roam. Track your count in Stats. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); stunt counting per PowerPyx's trophy guide.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: the game's activities include fishing, hunting, drone racing, arcade games, shooting range, bowling, meditation, racing and stunt-style challenges (the exact nine are listed in the in-game activities menu). You only need to start and finish one of each — no wins or high scores required. Do this early, alongside the story, so you also learn where everything is. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); activity list per GTA Wiki.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at the gun ranges around Leonida. Each challenge has a score threshold for gold, shown before you start — use the weapon the challenge specifies, aim for headshots and bonus targets, and replay any challenge you miss gold on (replays are unlimited, so nothing is missable). Work through the ranges one at a time and tick them off here. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles; 42 challenges per the list); method per PowerPyx's trophy guide.
trophies.name: The Shootist

Replay any challenge you miss gold on — replays are unlimited, so nothing is missable. Work through the ranges one at a time and tick them off here.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at every drone-race location in Leonida. Drone races are marked on the map once unlocked — fly the course, hit the checkpoints in order, and finish first. You only need one win per location, and races can be retried as often as you like. Learn each course's tight corners on a practice run before racing for the win. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); race locations per GTA Wiki.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: GTA Wiki — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once, so you need 20 separate race locations or variants, not 20 wins of the same race. Street, off-road and circuit races all count; pick a fast, well-handling car, learn the route, and move on to the next race after each win. The in-game race menu shows which you have won. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); race structure per PowerPyx's trophy guide.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest you can start at fishing spots once Cal is available as a rival. Score more (or bigger) catches than him before the timer ends: cast where the fish gather, reel steadily without snapping the line, and use better bait if the spot offers it. You can retry the challenge if you lose. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); fishing mechanics per GTA Wiki.

Pick the shortest cabinet you find; no high score is needed, just a completed run. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are marked scenic viewpoints — sit, start the meditation prompt, and let it complete; each spot counts once. They are all reachable in free roam after the story, so sweep them region by region (Vice City, the Keys, the interior wetlands) and tick them off. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); spot distribution per GTA Wiki.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a special hunting target Bret asks you to track down. Take the hunting request, follow the tracks and clues to the animal's area, and take it down with a clean shot (a scoped rifle helps; spooking it can make it flee, but the hunt can be retried). The trophy pops when the unique animal is delivered to Bret. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); hunting details per PowerPyx's trophy guide.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets — cards are hidden around Leonida (in shops, interiors, out in the wilds) and grouped into sets; finishing any 3 sets earns the silver. Cards stay collectible in free roam after the story, so sweep them with a map checklist region by region. You do not need every set — just three complete ones. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); card locations per PowerPyx's collectible guide.

Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); WAiNK locations per GTA Wiki.

Pick the easy ones first — short stunt, driving and exploration challenges — and track progress in the challenge menu. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it while your partner is with you: build a 4-star wanted level together (commit crimes with your partner in the car or on foot), then lose the cops and escape the search area while your partner is still with you. If your partner leaves or the story moves on, the window closes until another partner segment. Easiest right after a story mission that leaves your partner beside you: cause chaos, watch the stars hit 4, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); partner mechanic per PowerPyx's trophy guide.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do it while your partner is with you: rob 3 shops in a row, back-to-back, without ever losing your wanted level (keep at least 1 star the whole time). Plan a route of 3 nearby shops, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next — do not let the cops drop or you fail the chain and must restart it. Do this during a partner segment of the story, before the finale. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); method per PowerPyx's trophy guide.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Trigger it in a firefight with at least 5 enemies close together — gang hideouts or police shootouts work well — and chain headshots while focus lasts. If you run out of targets, let the attempt end and try again; it is repeatable anywhere there are enough enemies. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Combat Focus per GTA Wiki.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get a plane (or steal one on the tarmac) and take off from VCIA without following the normal departure routine — the trophy pops when you leave the airport airspace by air on your own terms. Airport security will chase you, so go in fast, grab a plane and climb. Save before you try, and do it before the final mission in case the airport locks down. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); method per PowerPyx's trophy guide.

The tank itself is the requirement, so any Rhino you can reach counts. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); Rhino locations per GTA Wiki.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Go in quiet: enter when the shop is empty, avoid the cameras' cones and the clerk's line of sight, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose any heat, and try again; jewelry robberies are repeatable, so this is not missable. Source: official trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles); stealth approach per PlayStationTrophies.org.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — banks with vaults are marked around Leonida; plan the approach, crack or blast the vault, grab the cash and escape the wanted level. Each vault counts once, so you need 5 different banks (or the same bank after it resets). Bring armor, a fast getaway car, and do them one at a time between other activities.
